groups.title: Account · resume and switch
groups.summary: Resolve the authenticated account before protected navigation. Existing combined profile forms remain canonical.

cases.title: Session · checking
cases.heading: Checking your account
cases.body: Please wait while we check your session and setup.
notes: Neutral startup; no authentication-form flash or protected cached content. External outcomes: account_resume, account_terms_missing, account_check_failed or authorized role Home.

cases.title: Setup · incomplete profile
cases.heading: Finish your student details
cases.body: Your account is signed in. Complete your details before continuing.
notes: Resume the existing single combined profile, preserving confirmed non-sensitive fields. Google uses google-profile with read-only provider email and no password. Do not create another account.

cases.title: Setup · missing agreement
cases.heading: Review the Terms
cases.body: Complete the required agreement before opening Home.
notes: Resume missing agreement only; preserve completed profile. Registration acceptance records actual version, actor and server time. No invented future reacceptance policy.

cases.title: Session · connection failure
cases.heading: Could not check your account
cases.body: Reconnect and try again. Your session status has not been confirmed.
notes: A transport failure does not prove sign-out. Keep protected content hidden while account identity is uncertain.

cases.title: Account · signing out
cases.heading: Signing out
cases.body: Closing this account before another account can open.
notes: Cancel account subscriptions and in-flight work; clear protected account caches before account_signedout. No automatic success transition in prototype.

cases.title: Account · signed out
cases.heading: You are signed out
cases.body: Sign in to open your account.
notes: No previous-account records remain visible. Signing out does not delete the account or restart registration for completed returning users.

cases.title: Account · switched destination
cases.heading: Home
cases.body: This account has no requests yet.
notes: Explicit empty-new-account fixture after account_check confirms the new account. Returning accounts instead load their own authorized records; staff and Teller open their role destinations. Ignore late results from the previous account.

cases.title: Google · identity not eligible
cases.heading: Use your institutional Google account
cases.body: This Google identity could not be accepted. Choose a verified @tip.edu.ph account.
notes: Separate wrong-domain and unverified-provider outcomes may reuse this composition. Grant no protected access and do not expose provider tokens.

groups.title: Catalog · request-type fees and quotes
groups.summary: Each authorized request type has a versioned pending, free or required declaration. Later edits never reprice submitted records.

cases.title: Office · request-type catalog
cases.heading: Request types
cases.body: Manage the types published by your authorized office.
notes: Non-official examples. Populate only permitted office types; no office-wide default fee. Type editor includes approved delivery mode and evidence requirements.

cases.title: Type · fee editor
cases.heading: Edit request type
cases.body: Review this type's declaration before saving.
notes: Amount/currency required only for Required; require positive valid amount. Free explicitly stores zero. Pending/missing declaration blocks student Submit. No invented fees or validation ranges.

cases.title: Type · invalid declaration
cases.heading: Check the fee declaration
cases.body: Correct the highlighted values before reviewing.

fields.label: Amount
fields.value: Missing or invalid · enter a positive amount

notes: Render adjacent field errors; preserve entered configuration. Client validation is not authority to write another office's catalog.

cases.title: Type · review change
cases.heading: Review catalog change
cases.body: This change applies to future request submissions.
notes: Show actual selected type, requirements and delivery mode. Trusted save checks office capability and expected catalog version.

cases.title: Type · saving
cases.heading: Saving request type
cases.body: Your reviewed change is being saved.
notes: Block duplicate writes. External result goes to catalog_saved or catalog_failed; lost response uses uncertain_check with catalog context.

cases.title: Type · saved
cases.heading: Request type updated
cases.body: The office's change was confirmed.
notes: After committed update, authorized student forms refresh or flag stale quotes. Frozen submitted snapshots remain unchanged.

cases.title: Type · failed
cases.heading: Request type was not saved
cases.body: Your edits are still here. Review the current type before trying again.
notes: Definite rejection only. Version conflict requires reloading current values and review. Lost-response uncertainty cannot claim the previous value is unchanged.

cases.title: Student · stale quote
cases.heading: Review the updated request
cases.body: This request type changed after your last review. Submit again only after reviewing the current details.

fields.label: Previous review
fields.value: Previous fee state / amount / currency / version

fields.label: Current quote
fields.value: Current server fee state / amount / currency / version

notes: No automatic submit or silent repricing. Show changed requirements/delivery as applicable. Pending declaration uses quote_pending.

cases.title: Student · refreshed review
cases.heading: Review current details
cases.body: Check the office's current declaration before submitting.

fields.label: Fee
fields.value: Current authoritative configured amount and currency

notes: Required-fee fixture only when actual amount/currency loaded. Free variant shows zero and bypasses payment. Submission atomically validates version and freezes snapshot. Inactive type disables Submit.

cases.title: Student · quote unavailable
cases.heading: Fee declaration unavailable
cases.body: The office has not confirmed the fee for this type. You cannot submit it yet.
notes: Check again requires authoritative reload; do not assume it resolves to Required. Missing/inactive catalog and failed refresh reuse blocked layout with precise copy, preserving form input.

groups.title: Live updates · reconnect
groups.summary: Keep last known content visible with honest freshness while authorized snapshots close missed-event gaps.

cases.title: Live · reconnecting
cases.heading: Requests
cases.body: Reconnecting. These are the last updates received.
notes: Contextual banner, not a replacement dashboard. Reuse in authorized office queue, appointments, inbox and notifications. No fabricated realtime success.

cases.title: Live · snapshot refresh
cases.heading: Checking latest updates
cases.body: Retrieving the latest records for this account.
notes: External canonical snapshot closes missed-event gaps. Dedupe identities/versions and ignore old responses. Reauthentication refreshes subscription credentials.

cases.title: Live · current snapshot
cases.heading: Requests
cases.body: Latest updates received.
notes: Non-official existing-record fixture. Committed office update changes student detail/list and authorized notifications once. Ready is never Completed. Later stale Processing events must not regress this display.

cases.title: Live · refresh failed
cases.heading: Requests
cases.body: Could not get the latest updates. The list may be out of date.
notes: Keep action availability conservative where fresh eligibility is required. Reconnect does not resubmit a pending mutation. Access revocation hides inaccessible content rather than retaining it indefinitely.

groups.title: Interrupted operations · reconcile
groups.summary: A lost response is neither success nor definite failure. Check operation identity before offering another attempt.

cases.title: Operation · checking outcome
cases.heading: Checking what happened
cases.body: The connection stopped before we received a result. We are checking the original operation.

fields.label: Operation
fields.value: Original account, profile, request, catalog, message or assignment operation

notes: Render role-appropriate shell and specific operation label. Reconcile authoritative operation/record identity with the same idempotency key. Never repeat Create, Submit, Send or Assign while uncertain. External results: uncertain_done, uncertain_not_done or uncertain_offline.

cases.title: Operation · completed result
cases.heading: Update confirmed
cases.body: The original operation completed. You do not need to send it again.

fields.label: Result
fields.value: Authoritative record identity and server time

notes: Context-specific destinations: account creation → account-created, profile → account_check, request → confirmed detail, catalog → catalog_saved, message → inquiry_read, assignment → inquiry_assigned. Account creation still requires explicit Sign in. No fabricated reference.

cases.title: Operation · not completed result
cases.heading: No update was saved
cases.body: The check confirmed that this operation did not complete. Your recoverable input is still here.

fields.label: Input
fields.value: Preserved non-sensitive form or unsent message

notes: Choose original context form: existing profile/registration, request, catalog_edit, inquiry thread or inquiry_selected. Retry same logical operation safely; do not substitute demo values. Do not persist plaintext passwords.

cases.title: Operation · still unknown
cases.heading: Result still unavailable
cases.body: Reconnect to check the original operation before trying again.
notes: Do not label as failed or offer duplicate submission. Account switch clears old account view and cancels its pending client work; another account cannot reconcile or see its result.

groups.title: Inquiries · assignment and unread
groups.summary: Students choose an office; authorized staff assign permitted recipients. Read state and messages remain account scoped.

cases.title: Assignment · recipients
cases.heading: Assign inquiry
cases.body: Choose a recipient permitted for this office and your capability.

fields.label: Permitted recipients
fields.value: Office personnel / Guidance counselor / CCS secretary / CCS faculty · capability labels only

notes: Non-official capability fixture, not a universal recipient list. Runtime exposes only actual authorized recipients. No student assignment controls; no invented names.

cases.title: Assignment · selected review
cases.heading: Review assignment
cases.body: Confirm the selected recipient for this inquiry.
notes: Selected recipient required before enabled confirmation. Preserve current ownership until trusted save confirms the new one.

cases.title: Assignment · saving
cases.heading: Changing assignment
cases.body: Checking the selected recipient and saving the change.
notes: External outcomes inquiry_assigned or inquiry_assignment_blocked. Lost response uses uncertain_check, never a blind retry.

cases.title: Assignment · confirmed thread
cases.heading: Office inquiry
cases.body: Assignment updated.

fields.label: Conversation
fields.value: Existing authorized messages, sender and timestamps

notes: Only after committed save. Refresh permissions and lists for affected staff; a previous assignee losing access must not keep thread content.

cases.title: Assignment · unavailable recipient
cases.heading: Choose another recipient
cases.body: The recipient is no longer available to you. The assignment was not changed.
notes: Definite rejection only. Empty authorized-recipient variant displays No recipients available and disabled Confirm; Back returns to staff thread. Uncertain result instead uses uncertain_check.

cases.title: Inbox · unread thread
cases.heading: Inbox
cases.body: An office reply is waiting.

fields.label: Demo office inquiry
fields.value: Unread · latest reply preview · server time

notes: Non-official existing-record fixture, never seeded into fresh accounts. Staff variant uses staff inbox and authorized assigned/office threads only. No typing or presence indicators.

cases.title: Inquiry · opened and read
cases.heading: Office inquiry
cases.body: Messages are grouped in this conversation.

fields.label: Office reply
fields.value: Demo reply · sender capability · server timestamp

fields.label: Unread
fields.value: Read state confirmed for this viewer

notes: Opening requests a viewer-specific read update; badge clears only with authoritative state. New committed replies append once; staff mirror uses G14.staff-sending. Lost send response uses uncertain_check; not a delivered/read receipt shown to sender.

cases.title: Inquiry · destination unavailable
cases.heading: Conversation unavailable
cases.body: This account cannot open this conversation. Return to your authorized inbox.
notes: Use role-correct staff/inbox destination for staff. Hide private content and composer after assignment/access changes. Notification navigation never grants access.

groups.title: Consultations · faculty and CCS
groups.summary: Students select faculty-specific availability; Faculty edits their own schedule and authorized CCS secretary coordinates permitted faculty.

cases.title: Student · choose CCS faculty
cases.heading: Faculty consultation
cases.body: Select a CCS faculty schedule to view available times.
notes: No invented faculty names or institutional schedules. Guidance remains a separate consultation path.

cases.title: Student · faculty times
cases.heading: Available consultations
cases.body: Choose a time for the selected faculty member.
notes: Use existing G09 no-times/full-slot variants. Demo fixtures are non-official; actual availability/capacity comes from trusted data.

cases.title: Student · booking review
cases.heading: Review consultation
cases.body: Confirm the selected faculty and time.
notes: Trusted operation atomically checks remaining capacity. Review alone creates no booking.

cases.title: Student · booking pending
cases.heading: Booking consultation
cases.body: Checking that the selected time is still available.

fields.label: Selection
fields.value: Selected faculty and published slot retained

notes: External success G09.1; capacity conflict G09.5.new-booking; definite failure consult_booking_failed; uncertain response uncertain_check with appointment context.

cases.title: Student · booking failed
cases.heading: Consultation was not booked
cases.body: Your selection is still here. Check current availability before trying again.
notes: Definite failure only; no appointment success marker. Cancellation/reschedule reuse existing G09 with same faculty identity and atomic capacity checks.

cases.title: Schedule · capability scope
cases.heading: Manage faculty availability
cases.body: Choose a schedule you are permitted to manage.
notes: Render as separate role fixtures. Faculty has no unrestricted selector. Server checks capability for every write; Guidance uses its own schedule, never CCS authority.

cases.title: Schedule · edit and save
cases.heading: Edit availability
cases.body: Review the selected schedule before saving.
notes: Show adjacent errors for missing/invalid configured values and preserve entries. Do not invent slot lengths, capacity or change policy for existing bookings.

cases.title: Schedule · saving
cases.heading: Saving availability
cases.body: Checking your access and saving the schedule.
notes: External success consult_schedule_saved; definite failure consult_schedule_failed; lost response uncertain_check. No automatic success transition.

cases.title: Schedule · confirmed
cases.heading: Availability updated
cases.body: The schedule change was confirmed.
notes: Committed availability refreshes permitted student views. Existing bookings cannot be silently cancelled by a layout edit.

cases.title: Schedule · failed
cases.heading: Availability was not saved
cases.body: Your changes are still here. Review the schedule and try again.
notes: For capability loss hide protected editor and return to authorized role view. Unknown result uses reconciliation rather than definite-failure copy.

groups.title: Settings · read-only Terms by role
groups.summary: All roles can read Terms and return to their originating Settings without changing consent or onboarding.

cases.title: Terms · Student return
cases.heading: Terms and Conditions
cases.body: Read-only notice. Institutional wording requires approval.
notes: Entry from Student Settings Terms and Conditions. No checkbox, Continue, registration or reconsent action. Viewing does not change accepted version or AI consent.

cases.title: Terms · Staff return
cases.heading: Terms and Conditions
cases.body: Read-only notice. Institutional wording requires approval.
notes: Entry from Staff Settings Terms and Conditions. Guidance, Faculty and CCS secretary retain their own capability shell. No agreement or registration action.

cases.title: Terms · Teller return
cases.heading: Terms and Conditions
cases.body: Read-only notice. Institutional wording requires approval.
notes: Entry from Teller Settings Terms and Conditions. Back preserves originating Settings. No acceptance write, onboarding restart or AI-consent change.
